verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no official cookbook, sample-app repository, or worked end-to-end example. The quickstart tours individual features: text generation, function calling, agents and background execution. That is feature coverage, not demonstrated end-to-end tasks. The Gemini API Skills for coding assistants inject SDK patterns, which is an adjacent aid rather than worked examples a developer can adapt.

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
